verdict.rationale: Kick connects banking via Plaid (12,000+ institutions, kick-docs-31), supports CSV/PDF upload for unsupported banks (kick-docs-4/23), syncs payments/invoicing from Stripe, Mercury, BILL (kick-docs-12/kick-supp-invoicing-billpay), and bill pay/payroll transactions flow into the ledger with automatic AI categorization (~97%) and journal entries (kick-supp-categorization, kick-supp-journal-entries, kick-docs-30). Missing for 10: explicit named payroll-provider integrations (e.g. Gusto/Rippling) beyond generic mention, and independent third-party verification of sync reliability.
